svg.title: Four time designs: cross-sectional, trend, cohort, and panel
svg.desc: Four rows compare three waves (2026, 2028, 2030). Each person icon carries a letter; the same letter means the same person. Cross-sectional: one sample (A–E) in wave 1 only. Trend: the same population of enrolled students, but different people each wave (A–E, then F–J, then K–O). Cohort: every icon wears a graduation cap for the class of 2026; each wave draws a new sample from that same cohort as it ages from about 22 to 26, so members may differ. Panel: the same people A–E appear in all three waves, linked by a line.

text.tspan: One sample drawn once from the population
Same population (enrolled students) · a new sample each wave
Same cohort (class of 2026) · a new sample each wave; members may differ
The same people (A–E) are interviewed in every wave
